description: Search documentation pages using keywords against page title, relative path, and first-paragraph summary. Returns matching page titles, paths, and summaries.

lang.description: Language to search: 'en' for English or 'zh' for Chinese. Defaults to 'en'.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return (1-20, default 5).

query.description: Keywords to search for in documentation titles, paths, and summaries.

name: search_docs
title: Search Documentation
